behavior: Business / Person Name is a searchable, keyboard-accessible customer dropdown with paginated active profiles.
Selecting an own customer fills name, TIN, address, email, phone and type. Profile revision is checked on save.
Add new buyer captures details and saves the customer atomically with a successfully saved invoice or draft. Failed financial/authority validation leaves no orphan profile.

Unambiguous existing buyer profiles are reused. Conflicting identities, multiple matches and inactive profiles require explicit customer review. Name or email alone never authorizes cross-tenant data access.
New customer profiles do not create user accounts, send email or assert BIR registration.
Existing customer contacts are not silently overwritten by invoice-only address/contact changes.
Draft and issued invoice relationships are visible in the customer profile, with independent pagination. Drafts remain excluded from recorded issued-invoice sales.
A per-form save UUID and merchant-scoped request hash prevent duplicate invoice/customer creation on HTTP retries, including when the server allocates a different invoice number.
safety_controls: All customer options, matching and links derive merchant ownership from the authenticated actor.
Matching uses merchant-scoped HMAC indexes over encrypted profiles; no matching hashes or review references are returned by the dropdown.
Merchant row lock serializes matching, creation and relationship writes in the invoice transaction.
Optional buyer-phone snapshots preserve old branch/expense review fingerprints when null; real source changes still invalidate review evidence.
Issued originals and existing review evidence are not rewritten.
Customer options, seller preview and invoice saving use the same deterministic owned-business selection and ApiAccess role/status boundary.

browser: Existing XYZ Enterprises profile selected from search; buyer fields prefilled.
Synthetic Automatic Buyer QA created by saving a draft; customer appeared in the directory automatically.
Customer profile showed the linked draft, with recorded issued sales still zero.
390px mobile viewport: document width equals viewport, no page overflow.

scope_notes: All manual workflow testing used the isolated SQLite QA environment with email delivery disabled.
No real customer, invoice, account or email was created during testing. Existing main database financial counts remained 3 business invoices and 13 receipts.
The implementation prepares buyer management and document relationships; it does not establish BIR approval or activate production EIS transmission.
